author: LadyLeigh
name: Pokemon
short: Opt-in Pokémon encounters, collections, trading, and friendly battles.
description: Component-based Pokémon game with cached PokéAPI data, spawns every 30 minutes with five-minute encounters, optional role notifications, Pokéstop supply rewards, family Candy, Stardust, a Red bank shop, trades, parties, and a basic battle engine. Disabled by default. Raids and complete cartridge move effects are not implemented.
install_msg: Use [p]pokeset to choose a spawn channel and explicitly enable Pokémon. Set an optional notification role in that menu. Use [p]pokestop for supplies and [p]pokecatch to catch the current encounter, or open [p]pokemon for the player menu. First use downloads and caches official PokéAPI CSV data; allow several minutes. See pokemon/README.md for rules and battle limitations.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server trainer IDs, Pokémon, parties, inventory, XP, Candy, Stardust, trade proposals, Pokéstop cooldowns, and shop/trade order journals. Supports Red user deletion requests. Public encounter and trade messages remain in Discord.
